name: Zsírozás
description: Zsírozás ('Greasing') is a traditional Hungarian trick game. 2-4 players. 32-card Hungarian deck. Suits are IRRELEVANT. Win trick by matching rank of led card (last match wins). Sevens are WILD. Capture 'zsír' (grease) cards: Aces + Tens (10pts each, 80 total). 40+ pts wins hand.

overview.description: Zsírozás ('Greasing') is a traditional Hungarian trick game. 2-4 players. 32-card Hungarian deck. Suits are IRRELEVANT. Win trick by matching rank of led card (last match wins). Sevens are WILD. Capture 'zsír' (grease) cards: Aces + Tens (10pts each, 80 total). 40+ pts wins hand.

history.origins: Zsírozás (Zsíros or Zsír) belongs to an unusual group of card games found only in Central and Eastern Europe. It is closely related to the Czech Sedma, Serbian/Bosnian Sedmice, Romanian Șeptică, and Hola; the name means 'to fatten' in Hungarian, referring to playing aces or tens into tricks. The game may have originated in Hungary or Poland and spread through the region; it has been played in Hungary at least since the 1930s.
timeline: 20th century: Part of the Sedma group of Central European games; widely played in Hungary.

rules.objective: Capture the majority of the 80 card-points in the pack: aces and tens (zsír, 'grease') count 10 points each; win a hand by taking 40 or more of these points.
rules.gameplay: Lead any card. Win by playing SAME RANK as led card (last match wins). Seven = WILD (matches any led). 'Greasing': winner can extend trick by leading again. A=10pts, 10=10pts. Total=80. 40+ wins. Tie: last trick winner wins.

variations.name: Long game
variations.description: Play to 10 game points instead of 5.

scoring.description: 40-70=1pt. All 80 (not all cards)=2pts ('kopasz'). All 80 + all cards=3pts ('csupasz').
